subject: Greenline trial kickoff: success criteria, owners, and next steps
messages:
From: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
To: sophie.turner@greenline.ai, jake.morales@greenline.ai
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greenline trial kickoff: success criteria, owners, and next steps

Hi Sophie / Jake —

Thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap and the concrete plan so we have a shared checklist to move into the 4-week trial. I captured the things we agreed on during the call and the owners we discussed.

1) High-level goal (what success looks like)
- Improve entity extraction and matching accuracy for company records in Greenline’s CRM: target improvement of +12–15 F1 over baseline on the sample set (see KPIs in attached MOP).
- Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms for synchronous enrichment calls at average batch sizes (see traffic assumptions).

2) Evaluation plan / datasets
- You’ll provide a) a static sample of 1,200 labelled records (CSV) and b) access (read-only API key) to a staging endpoint for live enrichment testing.
- Redwood will run an initial baseline run (3 business days) and share a short report and example failures.

3) Trial timeline (4 weeks starting next Monday 8/24)
- Week 0 (8/24–8/28): data ingest + baseline run (owner: Ben)
- Week 1 (8/31–9/4): model variant A tests + tuning loop (owner: Rafael)
- Week 2 (9/7–9/11): integration tests with staging traffic and latency tuning (owner: Monica)
- Week 3 (9/14–9/18): rollout smoke checks + acceptance report (owner: Rafael/Greenline)
- Acceptance call scheduled for 9/18 (final sign-off).

4) Roles & immediate action owners
- Greenline: Sophie (data delivery), Jake (integration + staging access)
- Redwood: Ben Carter (data ingest & baseline), Monica Patel (integration lead), Rafael Mendes (trial lead and final acceptance)

5) Risks / open questions
- Data format mismatch: confirm encoding and field mapping before ingest (Sophie).
- SSO / network restrictions for staging APIs — Jake to share firewall requirements.
- Retention & logs: we discussed 30-day ephemeral cache; if audit logs are required we’ll add retention options to the MOP.

6) Next steps (short list)
- Sophie: upload labelled CSV to the Drive folder and confirm by EOD Tue (8/25).
- Jake: create a staging API key and whitelist Redwood’s IPs by Wed (8/26).
- Ben: start baseline immediately after data lands and post results to the Drive folder.
- Rafael/Monica: send weekly check-in on Mondays and surface blockers.

Attachments: greenline_trial_scope_v1.pdf (trial scope), greenline_mop_kpis.xlsx (success metrics & measurement plan).

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Sophie — thanks. Quick answers and confirmations below; I’ll track the action items in the Drive MOP doc as they complete.

- CSV: please upload the full labelled CSV (zipped is fine). Ben can handle a ~1.4k row file immediately.
- Logs / retention: Redwood’s default trial retention is 30 days of operational logs & KV cache; we can enable 90-day audit exports as an add-on for the trial — Monica will own the configuration and provide the export artifact to your compliance team. Note that the longer retention option will require an addendum that we can sign during the trial (no change to baseline pricing for the evaluation).
- IP allowlist: our public egress IPs for staging are listed here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-greenline-trial-mop (I added a short text file). If your infra needs specific CIDR ranges let us know and Ben will provide them.

Action updates:
- Sophie: once you upload the file Ben will run the baseline within 24–72 hours.
- Jake: please send the staging URL + test API key to ben.carter@redwood.com and monica.patel@redwood.com.
- Monica: I’ve added you to the acceptance checklist (Week 3) — please confirm you can run integration smoke tests during 9/7–9/11.

I’ll schedule the 9/18 acceptance call — sending calendar invites after we confirm staging access.

Best,
Rafael

P.S. I dropped the MOP and KPIs spreadsheet into the folder: greenline_mop_kpis.xlsx
